name: Reactance -Futsugou na Shinjitsu-
source:
The onee-san who moved in the apartment downstairs had a mysterious charm that drew me in.

She was the flashy opposite of the plain and unpopular me.
Who would have thought that a girl overflowing with such sex appeal would seduce me and take my virginity!
I have no idea what she likes in me but, since then, she comes and we have sex every day.

However, she seems to have some kind of secret and that darkness is catching me in little by little...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.evil-heal.com/products/Reactance/]official website[/url]]
translation:
搬到楼下公寓的大姐姐，有一种神秘的魅力，深深吸引着我。

她光彩照人，与平凡又不受欢迎的我截然相反。

谁能想到，这样性感迷人的女人，竟会主动诱惑我，夺走我的第一次！

我完全不明白她看中了我哪一点，但从那以后，她每天都会来，与我做爱。

然而，她似乎隐藏着某种秘密，而那份黑暗正一点点将我卷入…

[译自[url=http://www.evil-heal.com/products/Reactance/]官方网站[/url]]
